title: Buildings take less phone memory: positions stored at half precision
items: Every building's corners are now stored as 16-bit numbers instead of 32-bit, scaled per building, so each vertex carries 20 bytes instead of 24. That frees about 5 MB of graphics memory on the 1835 phone view, and the town looks the same.
Wall and roof textures still line up exactly where they did, and tapping a building still opens its card.
